whenToUse: The task takes more than a few seconds, such as an upload or export.
People may use other screens until it finishes.
It must be possible to cancel while in progress.
whenNotToUse: The task finishes within a second (a spinner or button state is enough).
Other actions must be blocked until it finishes.
The progress can't be known (use a spinner).

alternatives.name: Progress Bar
alternatives.reason: Showing progress within the task's own screen.

alternatives.name: Toast
alternatives.reason: Only briefly reporting the finished result.

accessibility: The message sits in role="status", so start, completion, and cancellation are read politely.
The bar has role="progressbar" and announces its current value with aria-valuenow.
The cancel button shows only while in progress and turns into the result message when done.
With reduced motion, the bar changes instantly without a transition.
